One thing that would help me pin this down: where are these notifications hitting you — the Windows companion app, the Android app, or the portal itself (pop-ups in the browser)?

Ah, that makes more sense — so it's HaloPSA firing off notifications (most likely emails to the client or your team) every time the portal posts an approved call summary to a ticket.

Quick one to sharpen the report: are these notifications going to the client, your own technicians, or both — and is it roughly one per approved call, or does a single approval seem to trigger several?

My best guess at the cause: when the portal posts a note to Halo it likely isn't setting Halo's "don't notify on this action" flag on the API call, so Halo's ticket-update action rules fire every time. Worth trying in the meantime: check your Halo action rules for ticket updates and see if they can be scoped to ignore notes from the integration.

Right — so one notification per approved call or remote session, landing on your team in Halo rather than the client. That's a clear enough picture: the feature request is essentially "add an option to suppress or batch Halo's ticket-update notifications when the portal posts notes, so techs aren't pinged for every approval."

I've got what I need — thanks for clarifying.
